summary: fix(settings): report readable Glean reasons for passkey errors
description:
Because:

- Most passkey WebAuthn errors reported unreadable or shared Glean reasons.
- The add-passkey page used its own reason map and auth_error_<n> values.

This commit:

- Gives each WebAuthn error name its own Glean reason, and the duplicate case already_registered.
- Uses the shared gleanReason and named errno reasons on the add-passkey page.
- Picks the sign-in banner from errorType, so banners do not change.
- Documents every reason value in fxa-ui-metrics.yaml.

Closes FXA-14005
